title: Open Source Software Engineering Contributor
claim_source_title: Google Summer of Code Official Program Timeline
notes: Mentored software development for global open-source organizations. Google provides a stipend calibrated to Nigerian purchasing power.
eligibility_summary: Open worldwide (18+), 100% remote from Nigeria. High attainability for students with strong Git and open-source contributions.

title: Open Source Software Engineering Intern
notes: Paid $7,000 USD stipend for 3 months of remote open-source engineering under senior mentorship. Initial application essays precede a 4-week public contribution phase.
eligibility_summary: 100% remote open to applicants underrepresented in tech or subject to systemic bias in their home country (Nigeria fully eligible).

title: Software Engineering & Production Engineering Fellow
notes: 12-week remote fellowship contributing to real production codebases (open source and partner enterprise software) with need-based stipends.
eligibility_summary: 100% remote open to Nigerian students. Requires technical interview and code sample review.

title: Cloud Native & Kernel Software Mentee
claim_source_title: Linux Foundation LFX Mentorship Term Schedule
notes: Full-time or part-time summer mentorship working on CNCF, Linux kernel, GraphQL, Hyperledger, and OpenSSF projects with competitive stipends.
eligibility_summary: Remote global applicants accepted. Mentee selection based on technical background in C, Go, Python, or TypeScript.

title: 3rd-Year Software Engineering SIWES / Attachment Matching
claim_source_title: PAU Career Services Official Industrial Training Guidance
notes: Direct university placement pipeline connecting Pan-Atlantic University software engineering undergraduates with vetted Lagos tech hubs and fintech partners.
eligibility_summary: Exclusive to enrolled PAU software engineering students in Lagos (Ibeju-Lekki / Victoria Island / Ikeja corridors).

title: GitHub Octernships Software Engineering Projects
notes: Paid remote software engineering internships partnering GitHub with tech companies worldwide. Cycles are posted on a rolling basis; re-checked weekly.
eligibility_summary: Open to verified GitHub Student Developer Pack holders worldwide, including Nigerian university students.

title: Software Engineer Trainee / Graduate Intern
notes: Canonical hires 100% remote engineers and early-career trainees across all time zones including West Africa. Exact posting windows vary by team.
eligibility_summary: Fully remote worldwide with competitive USD compensation. Rigorous written interview and technical aptitude assessment.

title: Software Engineering Intern / SIWES Placement
claim_source_title: Moniepoint Official Careers & Early Talent Hub
notes: Premier Nigerian banking & fintech infrastructure provider based in Lagos. Offers dedicated industrial attachment and SIWES internships.
eligibility_summary: Onsite / hybrid in Lagos (Oyo / Lekki). Open to Nigerian undergraduate engineering students.

title: Switchers Early Career & SIWES Engineering Intake
notes: Nigeria's flagship transaction switching infrastructure. Regular annual industrial training intake coordinated via university SIWES offices.
eligibility_summary: Onsite at Victoria Island, Lagos. Open to 3rd-year Nigerian university students with IT/SIWES letters.

title: Software Engineering Internship
notes: Leading modern payments infrastructure in Africa. Ad-hoc and periodic software engineering internship cohorts; re-checked weekly for active postings.
eligibility_summary: Lagos onsite/hybrid and remote in Nigeria. Focused on modern web technologies (React, Node.js, TypeScript).

title: Graduate & Student Engineering Placement
notes: Pan-African cross-border payments enterprise based in Lagos. Periodically accepts SIWES and graduate engineering interns.
eligibility_summary: Lagos onsite / hybrid. Open to Nigerian university students.

title: Early Career Software Engineering Trainee
notes: Digital bank operating in Lagos, London, and Cape Town. Technical teams recruit interns across backend, mobile, and web infrastructure.
eligibility_summary: Lagos onsite / hybrid. Open to computer science and software engineering students.
